# How to calculate values that change the speed of a projectile without affecting its arc

Source: [wiki article 4855](../archive/4855.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4855-n1"></a>

- Documented arc-preserving projectile modification multiplies speed by k and gravity by k squared; settings use percentages, so speed=100*k and gravity=100*k*k.

<a id="wiki-4855-n2"></a>

- Example scales Baptiste Immortality Field from documented 60 m/s to 20 m/s, changes settings around the cast, then restores both to 100.

<a id="wiki-4855-n3"></a>

- Motivation: shared projectile arcs between Baptiste field/secondary fire and Zarya graviton/secondary fire can be preserved while changing travel time.
